title: Pip the Bunny Is Afraid of the Dark | Bedtime Story for Kids #shorts
description:
Little Pip the bunny is scared of the dark... until a lost baby mouse needs help! A gentle bedtime story about being brave, even when you feel scared.
Perfect for kids 3-8 — follow Tiny Toon Tales for more sweet stories.
